Six Girls in New Zealand Getting Meat While on a long drive from the Coromandel to Matamata (where The Shire is), we pulled into this pizza place to stock up on some much needed carbs.  I saw these six girls lined up so perfectly, I had to grab a quick shot.Most places in New Zealand outside of the cities seem to shut down about 8 PM.  I had to start getting used to planning ahead to get dinner!  It's hard for me because I usually just go go go go until after sunset, taking photos like a madman... and THEN I think about dinner.   But that trick doesn't really work when you're on the road there...- Trey RatcliffClick here to read the rest of this post at the Stuck in Customs blog.
